items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee addresses Barry Martyn directly multiple times (e.g., 'Well, the thing about it, Barry, you know...', 'Well, I'll tell you one thing, Barry.') indicating they are present and interacting, but no specific professional or personal relationship beyond acquaintance is described in the te

ctx.x: Well, they have Mardi Gras in Munich, Germany, and they call it "faschen"(?) or something, so I guess they would have it in somewhere like Baton Rouge. But it never occurs to you. Everything in the Deep South centers around New Orleans, so you naturally think of the New Orleans Mardi Gras.
Well, the thing about it, Barry, you know, everybody can't go to New Orleans.
